text:
lucy: Quick PSA  someone swapped the labeled ketchup for a mystery hot sauce. My avo toast was adventurous. :sweat_smile:
ben: Guilty-ish. thought it was the spicy ketchup. Sorry! Wheres the labeled ketchup jar now?
maya: Can we agree: if you move someones labeled jar, relabel it immediately. Tiny sticky note solves this.
fridge-bot: Note: labeled items detected: 3. Unlabeled jars: 1 (top shelf). Please label or remove within 24h.
lucy: Also can we add a tiny "Do not swap" sticker for personal jars? Simple black on yellow.
ben: Ill buy a sticker roll and leave $3 in the pantry kitty. Promise to double-check next time.
pantry-bot: Purchase request created: sticker roll (do-not-swap) + small permanent marker. Ticket #4425. React with :+1: to approve.
maya: Love it. Also tiny etiquette: if you finish communal condiments, replace or write "will replace by date". Cuts confusion.
lucy: Agree. I'll put a little laminated sign by the shelf: "Label personal. Replace communal. Ask before swapping"
ben: Thanks all. Ketchup is back to normal and my avo survived. :relieved:
